properties.name: text-index
properties.purpose:
The tantivy-backed full-text index behind `search_design` — BM25 keyword search over every property the schema marks `fulltext`.

Absorbed from `dynograph-text` at v0.12.0 on 2026-08-24 into `crates/reflow2-core/src/foundation/text.rs` — 847 lines, reached only through the `fulltext` feature.

🛑 IT WAS INVISIBLE TO EVERY EARLIER COSTING OF THE ABSORPTION. reflow2 never named `dynograph-text` in any manifest: it arrived transitively through `dynograph-storage`'s optional `fulltext` feature, which reflow2 enables. Three separate scopings of this work counted five crates; there were six. **A dependency reached only through a feature flag is absent from the dependency list a reader would check**, and it brought `tantivy` with it.

⚠️ AND IT IS THE ONE PIECE WITH A KNOWN HISTORY OF LEAKING. The v0.11.0 → v0.12.0 pin bump was made precisely because `search_fulltext` returned `dynograph_text::TextHit` — a type from a crate reflow2 never named, reachable only through an optional feature. In-tree that class of leak stops being possible: there is no boundary left for a type to cross unnoticed.

(Distinct from `dep:dynograph-foundation`, the Resource recording the external dependency this ENDS, and from reflow2's own search module, which is the caller rather than the index.)
